go-jsonschema generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Value

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": ["string", "integer", "boolean", "null"]
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/valuepkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestValue_RoundTripString(t *testing.T) {
	var v Value
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`"hi"`), &v); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	got, ok := v.TypeString()
	if !ok || got != "hi" {
		t.Errorf("TypeString = (%q, %v), want (hi, true)", got, ok)
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil || string(out) != `"hi"` {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = (%s, %v)", out, err)
	}
}

func TestValue_RoundTripInteger(t *testing.T) {
	var v Value
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`42`), &v); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	got, ok := v.TypeInteger()
	if !ok || got != 42 {
		t.Errorf("TypeInteger = (%d, %v), want (42, true)", got, ok)
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil || string(out) != "42" {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = (%s, %v)", out, err)
	}
}

func TestValue_RoundTripBoolean(t *testing.T) {
	var v Value
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`true`), &v); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	got, ok := v.TypeBoolean()
	if !ok || got != true {
		t.Errorf("TypeBoolean = (%v, %v), want (true, true)", got, ok)
	}
}

func TestValue_RoundTripNull(t *testing.T) {
	var v Value
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`null`), &v); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if !v.TypeNull() {
		t.Errorf("TypeNull = false, want true")
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil || string(out) != "null" {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = (%s, %v)", out, err)
	}
}

func TestValue_Setters(t *testing.T) {
	var v Value
	v.SetInteger(7)
	out, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil || string(out) != "7" {
		t.Errorf("after SetInteger: Marshal = (%s, %v)", out, err)
	}
	v.SetString("done")
	out, err = json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil || string(out) != `"done"` {
		t.Errorf("after SetString: Marshal = (%s, %v)", out, err)
	}
	if _, ok := v.TypeInteger(); ok {
		t.Errorf("TypeInteger ok after SetString, want false")
	}
}

func TestValue_RejectArray(t *testing.T) {
	var v Value
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`[1,2]`), &v)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want kind rejection")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "unexpected JSON kind") {
		t.Errorf("err = %q, want kind-rejection message", err)
	}
}
